name: Lord Fish Sea Food & Costillas Grill

tagline.es: Mariscos al carbón y torres frías en la Progreso
tagline.en: Charcoal seafood and chilled towers in Progreso

specialty: House 'Salsa Lord' octopus and shrimp, stuffed pineapples and towering cold seafood platters.

photo_notes.cover: Casual neighborhood seafood restaurant with bright tables, nautical touches and platters of shrimp and octopus under warm afternoon light.
photo_notes.s1: Halved pineapple filled with bubbling hot seafood and melted cheese on a wooden board.
photo_notes.s2: Tall cold seafood tower layered with shrimp, octopus, oysters, scallops and ceviche, lime wedges around.
photo_notes.s3: Charred grilled octopus tentacles glossed in a dark red house sauce on a black plate.
photo_notes.s4: Golden fried shrimp stuffed with cream cheese and wrapped in bacon, with dipping sauce.
